The `group_member.hbs` template gates the remove link with `{{#unless automatic}} ... {{/unless}}`, but `automatic` is a group attribute (used correctly in `group.hbs`), not a `Discourse.User`/member attribute, so in the per-member context it will be undefined/falsey and the `unless` will pass—showing the “remove” control even for automatic groups.
